name: prompt_for_question
description: The chatbot invites the user to ask any questions, explaining how it learns and communicates through Natural Language Processing (NLP).

name: prompt_for_support_contact_method
description: Prompts the user to inquire about available contact methods for support assistance.

children.name: present_alternative_communication_options
children.description: Presents the user with various options for assistance, including alternative support methods and frequently asked questions.

outputs.description: Options for additional support such as writing a query directly, viewing frequently asked questions, contacting for other inquiries, or speaking with an expert.

children.name: provide_contact_information
children.description: The chatbot provides the email address to contact for further assistance.

outputs.description: The email address provided as a contact for users seeking help.

children.name: present_consulted_topics_options
children.description: Presents a list of the most consulted topics and options available for the user to select and explore further regarding the services provided by Botslovers.

outputs.description: Popular inquiries regarding automating customer service and sales, integrations with tools, multilingual capabilities, personal response generation, and options related to customer service topics for selection.

children.name: present_client_overview
children.description: The chatbot provides an overview of prominent brands using Botslovers to automate customer service.

outputs.description: A list of notable clients using Botslovers, including Netflix, Porsche, and Movistar.

children.name: prompt_for_consultation_topic
children.description: Requests the user to specify the topic of their consultation after selecting the "Lo más consultado" option.

parameters.name: consultation_topic
parameters.description: The specific topic the user is interested in.

name: prompt_for_live_chat_availability_query
description: The chatbot permits the user to ask about the availability of live chat for quick queries.

name: prompt_for_email_confirmation
description: Prompts the user to confirm or provide their email address, offering options for email confirmation in the process.

children.name: request_email_for_specialist_connection
children.description: Requests the user's email address to connect them with a specialist for further assistance.

parameters.name: email_address
parameters.description: The email address provided by the user for contact and communication with a specialist.

children.name: acknowledge_transfer_to_specialist
children.description: The chatbot confirms that the user's conversation is being transferred to a specialist for further assistance.

children.name: provide_contact_confirmation
children.description: The chatbot confirms that the user will receive a response from a specialist as soon as possible.

children.name: confirm_email_address
children.description: Prompts the user to confirm their provided email address by repeating it back for verification before proceeding.

parameters.name: email_address
parameters.description: The confirmed email address provided by the user for verification.

name: provide_farewell_message
description: Delivers a friendly farewell message to the user when they indicate they no longer need assistance.

name: confirm_conversation_completion
description: Acknowledges the end of the interaction and expresses readiness to assist the user again in the future.

name: prompt_for_more_details
description: The chatbot asks the user to provide more information or rephrase their request when the previous response was unhelpful.
